paite: "Aw Israel, na hong kikleh, ka kiang ngel ahang kik ding ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Na kihhuainate ka mitmuh louh a na koihmang a, chihtaktak a, thugel diktak zang a diktattak a;
heading: Kisik Ding A Sapna
english: “If you will return, Israel,” says Yahweh, “if you will return to me, and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight; then you shall not be removed;

paite: TOUPA ahin lai teng, chi a na kichiamleh namte amah ah nuamsa akichi ding ua, amah asuangta ding uh.
english: and you shall swear, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.”

paite: "Judah mite leh Jerusalem kiang ah TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: Na lei sit uh let unla, lingte lak ah chỉ theh kei un.
english: For thus says Yahweh to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.

paite: Nou Judah gam a mi leh Jerusalem a tengte aw, TOUPA a ding in na zek uh sum unla, na lungtang zek uh sum un, huchi lou in zaw na thil gilou hihte uh ziak in, ka hehna mei bang in apawtkhe ding a, kuamah phelh theih louh in akang kha ding.
english: Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

paite: Judah gam ah hilh unla, Jerusalem ah puang un, Gam pumpi ah pengkul mut unla, ngaihtak in kikou un. Hong kikhawm unla, kulh nei khopite ah i lut ding uh, chi un;
heading: Dou A Om Ding Judah Vauhilhna
english: Declare in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, ‘Blow the trumpet in the land!’ Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves! Let us go into the fortified cities!’

paite: Zion lam ah puanzak khai unla, bitna zong in tai unla, zekai kei un, mallam a pan thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding, nakpi a siatna.
english: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don’t wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”

paite: Gammang nuai ning kitel a kipan in humpinelkai apawt hi, namte hihse ding; amun a kipan apawtta, ahong pai lellel hi, na gam hihse ding leh na khopite teng mi nei lou khop a sugawp ding in.
english: A lion is gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations; he is on his way, he is gone forth from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.

paite: Huaiziak in sai-ip puan teng unla, kap un, mau vongvong un; i lak ua kipan in TOUPA hehna thupi lah akikaikhe ngal kei a."
english: For this clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Yahweh hasn’t turned back from us.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in hichi ahong hi ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; kumpipa lungtang a lungke khin ding a, heutute lungtang leng; siampute'n gen ding athei kei ding ua, zawlneite'n lamdang asa ding uh."
english: “It shall happen at that day,” says Yahweh, “that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.”

paite: Huan ke'n, "Ah, Toupa PATHIAN, hiai mite leh Jerusalem nakpitak a khem na hi ve, 'Muanna na nei ding uh,' na chi a, namsau in hinna asun zawta," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You shall have peace;’ whereas the sword reaches to the heart.”

paite: Huai hun chiang in hiai mite leh Jerusalem kiang ah, "Gamdai tang giau velvul a kipan huih sa, ka tanu, ka mite zapsiang ding hilou; siangsak ding hi sam lou;
english: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse;

paite: Huih hat lua, ka thu in ahong tung ding ahi; tu in leng atungthu uh ngaihtuahpa kei ka hi,” chih ahi ding.
english: a full wind from these shall come for me. Now I will also utter judgments against them.”

paite: Ngai dih, ahong paitou ding, meipi bang in, akangtalai pingpei bang maite; asakolte muvanlai sang in ahatzaw uh, i tung gik na e! Buluh a om i hi ve ua.
heading: Judah, Melmate Umkimvelna
english: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as the whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! For we are ruined.

paite: Aw Jerusalem, thulimlouhna a kipan na lungtang silsiang inla, hotdam a na omtheihna ding in; bang tan ahia na ngaihtuahna gilou na pai ding?
english: Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long shall your evil thoughts lodge within you?

paite: Dan gam a kipan aw ahong pawtkhia a, Ephraim tang a kipan in thil hoih lou apuang hi.
english: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Ephraim:

paite: Namte hilh unla, Jerusalem ah puang un, "Ngai dih, gam gamlapi a kipan sual mite ahong tung uh, Judah khopite tung ah a-aw uh asuah uhi.
english: “Tell the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, ‘Watchers come from a far country, and raise their voice against the cities of Judah.

paite: Louma veng mite bang mai in akimvel in a-um ua, ka tung a ahel ziak un chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,’” says Yahweh.

paite: "Na omdan leh na thilhihte'n, hiaite na tung ah atun ahi, hiai na siatna ding ahi, ana mahmah a na lungtang sun ei ve."
english: “Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness; for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”

paite: Ka lung ana, ka lung ana, ka lungtang mahmah ana, ka sung ah ka lungtang abuaita a, ka om maimai thei kei, aw ka hinna, pengkul ging, kidouna husa ka zak ziak in.
heading: Amite Ziak A Jeremiah Lungzinna
english: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart; my heart is disquieted in me; I can’t hold my peace; because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

paite: Siatna tung ah siatna atungta, gam pumpi loh in a-omta, ka puaninte ahihse guih ua, ka puanzakte leng mitphiat kal lou in.
english: Destruction on destruction is cried; for the whole land is laid waste: suddenly are my tents destroyed, and my curtains in a moment.

paite: "Bang tan ahia kidouna puanzak ka muh ding a, pengkul ging ka zak ding?
english: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?

paite: Ka mite ahai mahmah ua lah athei ngal kei ua, naupang haitak, theihna nei lou bang mai ahi ua, thil gilou hih asiam ua, thil hoih hihdan asiam kei uh."
english: “For my people are foolish, they don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are skillful in doing evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.”

paite: Leitung ka etleh, ngai dih, segawp leh vuak in a-om a; vante'n vakna anei kei uh.
heading: Siatna Hong Tung Ding Jeremia In Amuhdan
english: I saw the earth, and, behold, it was waste and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.

paite: Tangte ka etleh, ngai in, aling uh, mual tengteng leng atang zualzual uh.
english: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.

paite: Ka etleh, ngai in, mihing a-om kei ua, tungleng vasate alengmang khinta uh.
english: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.

paite: Ka etleh, ngai in, louma hoihte gamdai asuak khin a, khopite leng achim khin, TOUPA leh ahehna mahmah ah.
english: I saw, and behold, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of Yahweh, before his fierce anger.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Gam pumpi asegawp ding, himahleh ka hihtawp tawntung kei ding."
english: For thus says Yahweh, “The whole land shall be a desolation; yet will I not make a full end.

paite: "Huaiziak in lei in asuun ding a, tunglam vante leng amial ding; thu ka genta a, ka tumta hi, ka kisik kei a, ka lunghei kei hi.
english: For this the earth will mourn, and the heavens above be black; because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.”

paite: Sakol tung a tuang leh thalpeu zang mite husa ah, khopi pumpi ataikek ua, gammang ah alut ua, kho chih anusia ua, luahmi khat lel leng om lou in.
english: Every city flees for the noise of the horsemen and archers; they go into the thickets, and climb up on the rocks: every city is forsaken, and not a man dwells therein.

paite: "Huan nang, loh a na om hun chiang in bangchi in na hih dia? Puan san-au a kizem in, kivatna dangka-eng a kivan in, na mitte nuh mah lechin, na kihih lawm thawn ahi, na tangvalte'n ahon simmoh ding ua, na hinna lak atum uhi.
english: You, when you are made desolate, what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck you with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with paint, in vain do you make yourself beautiful; your lovers despise you, they seek your life.

paite: Numei nauvei kikou husa ka za, tachil neinu thuak lai, Zion tanu nak ging, akhutte zak a, ka tung gik hi na mai e! Tualthat mite ma ah ka hinna abah khinta," chi in.
english: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who brings forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands, saying, “Woe is me now! For my soul faints before the murderers.”
